turns.question: How many leads did every 100 euros of social ad spend get us in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no leads-per-100-euros metric, so I can't give that figure; the closest is cost per lead, which was 52.5 EUR per lead for social campaigns over 1-30 September 2026 (2,100.0 EUR of ad spend for 40 leads). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
